dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why, aren't you an intelligent-looking youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: I'm Shushan. The trustiest stonemasons of Chenyu Vale have come from my family for generations now, ever since the time of my ancestors.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Many of the local stone buildings were built by my family.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Even after retiring, I still haven't found an apprentice worthy of inheriting my skills...
